name: Buy coins with Flutterwave (test mode)
steps: Log in as a player and open My Wallet
Buy 1,000 coins using a Flutterwave TEST card
Return to the app after payment
Replay the same webhook payload from the Flutterwave dashboard
expected: Wallet shows exactly +1,000 coins once. The replay does not credit again. A ledger row 'Coins purchased' appears.

name: Player cannot create or manage tournaments
steps: Log in as an ordinary player
Open #/admin directly
In the browser console call supabase.rpc('dg_admin_create_tournament', {...})
expected: Admin page shows 'Administrators only'. The RPC fails with 'Administrator access required'. No tournament is created.

name: Admin publishes a tournament with a unique link
steps: Log in as sylvesterokosodo@gmail.com (confirmed email)
Create two tournaments with the same name and publish both
Copy each link and open it in a private window
expected: Two different #/t/<slug> links. Both show prize, fee, game list and ~48h countdown to anonymous visitors.

name: Join, escrow, cancel, rejoin
steps: Join with sufficient coins
Check wallet: available decreased, escrow increased
Cancel entry; check refund
Try joining a tournament whose fee exceeds balance
expected: Coins move available -> escrow -> available. Insufficient balance shows an error and creates no entry.

name: Full tournament: bracket, play, admin approval, payout
steps: Fill a 4-player tournament with 4 test accounts
Each player opens their match and plays it to the end
As admin, approve each proposed winner
Approve the final
expected: Round 2 appears after round 1 approvals. Champion is announced under Winners, escrow is settled, bonus coins (if set) are credited.

name: Underfilled tournament expires with refunds
steps: Join a tournament that will not fill
In staging, set its registration_deadline into the past
Reload the app (or wait for the pg_cron job)
expected: Tournament shows REFUNDED/failed and the escrowed coins return to available balance.

name: All seven games are playable
steps: Open Games in the arena
Practise each game
Confirm layout fits a 360px-wide screen
expected: Every game accepts legal moves, rejects illegal ones and reports a winner or draw.
